cross_source_findings.evidence: The first page's screenshot at 23:43:46 shows country-status cards and the クエスト badge; the second page's screenshot shows the open task list. The written text does not describe pressing the control, and no clear video transition was found. The control-to-list transition is therefore unknown, not asserted.

boundaries: No full gameplay capture or hands-on interaction was performed. Navigation destinations not documented by official text are marked unknown.
Player screenshots are post-release but exact patch and state are unverified; small decorative labels and some numbers are difficult to read.
Official AliceSoft system page supplies authoritative rules and terms but explicitly cautions that screenshots and information are development-stage and may differ from the retail version.
The character portrait identity is intentionally left unknown where the cropped evidence does not establish it.

No player-visible numerical combat attributes are present in the two selected main-page states except regional force counts, projected human loss, and route-page party HP. No standalone enemy stat panel is evidenced here.
The released base-country-status page, selected-front operation panel, and quest-list-open page are separate captures/states. Do not combine their panels into one fixed layout.

The release-quest-list capture includes a Windows title/menu strip and its own lower-right X 閉じる; the separate base-country-status capture instead shows an in-game MENU button at lower left. Preserve that evidence distinction; the images alone do not establish whether this difference comes from screen state, capture framing, or build/platform.

Released route-choice cards in release-route-choice.jpg are green and blue with different copy than the official development screenshot system-04_01.jpg (red/green); retail screenshot is the authority for shipped colors and text.

The released base screenshot proves the top-right クエスト button is visible while four regional force cards are visible and no side quest list is open. No checked text/video proves that clicking that specific button opens the right-side list; transition remains unknown.
